g.text: Fixed seed 91: measured speeds across all physical lanes
25 m × 10 s bins; actual-vehicle sample mean; empty bins are white; common 0–33.3 m/s scale.
Representative seed fixed before viewing: all five seeds determine the reported effects; seed 91 includes reversed low-flow road DIDs.
